Gold.note: Central bank accumulation and rate cut expectations drive safe-haven demand.

Silver.note: Strong photovoltaic demand and structural supply deficits amplify the precious metals rally.

Copper.note: Electrification and grid demand outpace constrained mine supply growth.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and global nuclear reactor restarts support long-term contract prices.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and moderating EV demand growth weigh on pricing.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply and LFP battery substitution cap upside potential.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charge drops and mine closures tighten refined supply.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector and subdued steel demand suppress price upside.

Coal.note: High global inventories and long-term energy transition pressures offset short-term supply tightness.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and strategic stockpiling provide a floor despite weak current pricing.

Manganese.note: Steady steel demand balances ample South African and Gabonese supply.

PGM.note: Tightening South African power supply and hydrogen economy potential support prices.

Potash.note: Geopolitical supply constraints and steady global agricultural demand support prices.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production caps and rising green energy demand tighten primary supply.

Diversified.note: Broad commodity basket exposure benefits from copper and gold tailwinds offsetting iron ore weakness.
